conviction_note: The Sep quarter is legacy Paramount alone, against a guide the company has beaten before, so it should be in line to slightly better. The stock will trade on the first post-close outlook for the combined company: synergy pace, leverage path, and any 2027 frame. The one comparable print, the first post-merger print in Nov 2025 when the savings target was raised, gave +9.8%. That gives a mild long lean (p_up 56) on an abs move of 7.5. abs_move is rebuilt from this CIK's four confirmed 8-K 2.02 reactions (+9.8, +10.0, -4.2, +4.5) and the 8.63% four-day straddle. The baseline's 0.99% event-implied move is an artefact: the 20d realised vol includes the 14 Oct warrant ex-date crash. impact_sum (+1.6) and impact_scaled (+0.9) agree in sign. The scaled number is smaller because p_up carries the uncertainty about whether management quantifies anything new on the combined company.
bar: Company Q3 2026 guide from the 2026-08-04 release: revenue $6.95-7.15B (+4-7% y/y; midpoint $7.05B), adj. EBITDA $875-975M, Paramount+ subs 'flattish' q/q, ~$200M transformation costs (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2041610/000204161026000052/ex99_q226.htm). Aggregator consensus is unresolved and contradictory: EPS $0.11-0.13 (TheRightTrader / TipRanks), revenue $7.6B (TheRightTrader) or $16.48B (FXEmpire, apparently a combined-company figure) (https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/skyd/earnings). So the bar is the company guide. There is no sourced bar for the combined company's 2027 or synergy outlook, which is the line the stock most likely trades on, so the guidance findings are capped at moderate size.
positioning_check: Short interest 145.86M shares (settlement 2026-10-15), 3.56% of a 4.10B float, days to cover ~3.5-4.0 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/skyd/statistics/ ; https://stockmarketwatch.com/stock/SKYD/short-interest). Not a crowded short. Baseline skew is -25.5 vol points (25d call IV well above put IV: upside paid) with put/call OI 0.16. The option market leans long, so a long lean here agrees with the skew and is partly priced. Spot $8.285 is -50.5% from the 52w high and +21.8% from the 52w low. 20d run-up -9.55% is distorted by the 2026-10-14 warrant ex-date, a -22% close to $7.06 against a $0.19 NYSE mechanical adjustment (https://www.thewrap.com/industry-news/business/skydance-warrants-issued-stock-reaction/). 5d run-up +2.66%. The stock trades below the $12 equity-financing price and below the $12 warrant strike, a supply overhang. Consensus rating Hold or Reduce, average target ~$9.15.

findings.finding: First print after close, and the company tends to raise its savings targets: at the first post-Skydance-merger print (10 Nov 2025) it raised the cost-savings target from $2B to $3B, gave its first FY guide, and the stock rose +9.8% (15.25 to 16.74) despite missing estimates; at Q2 2026 it raised run-rate efficiencies from $2.5B to $2.7B. The current public target is >=$6B run-rate synergies within three years, 3.0x net leverage by end-2029 and >$10B FCF in 2030 (6 Oct 2026 closing release). Debtwire's base case credits only $1.75B by 2027 and puts net leverage at 6.16x on realised synergies, so the market discounts the target heavily (stock below the $12 financing price). An early quantification or upsizing on this call lands against a sceptical bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the same CIK, the Nov 2025 first post-merger print raised the savings target and set the first FY guide: +9.8% next session. The Feb 2026 print (FY guide reiterated, $30B revenue): +10.0%. Closes from Yahoo chart v8 (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SKYD?range=1y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: If the market believed the $6B target, the equity would trade nearer the $12 at which the financing investors bought, and Debtwire would not model 29% of it by 2027. The stock is -50% from its high, and the 2026-10-14 credit report models a fraction of the target. No new synergy number has been published since close, so any quantification on the call is new information.
findings.independence: Savings-target precedent: https://senalnews.com/en/data/paramount-skydance-reports-q3-loss-after-merger-but-sets-new-strategy-for-growth (2025-11-11). Q2 efficiency raise: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2041610/000204161026000052/ex99_q226.htm. Debtwire scepticism: https://ionanalytics.com/insights/debtwire/skydance-corporation-synergies-alone-wont-hit-leverage-targets-credit-report/ (2026-10-14). The sign of this finding is inference from precedent, not a document.

findings.finding: Legacy Paramount beat its own Q2 adj. EBITDA guide by a wide margin ($1,099M actual against a $0.9-1.0B guide, +16% vs midpoint) and raised FY26 to $3.8-3.9B. The Q3 guide of $875-975M was framed as lower on content-amortisation timing, so it is a conservative bar the company has a record of clearing; expect Q3 EBITDA at or above the top of the range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 EBITDA beat and FY raise (4 Aug 2026): +4.5% next session (8.38 to 8.76). Q1 2026 (4 May): -4.2% (11.13 to 10.66) with a same-day analyst downgrade. Both from Yahoo chart v8 closes.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the beat habit is visible. It is sized small because the reported quarter belongs to a pre-close standalone entity that the stock no longer trades on. Aggregator EPS bars ($0.11-0.13) and revenue bars ($7.6B, $16.48B) disagree, so nobody holds a clean bar on this line.
findings.independence: The Fox proxy finding below points the same way through the ad line. It is a different source (Fox 8-K / TheDesk).

findings.finding: The ad market in the Sep quarter ran hot for broadcast. Fox's fiscal Q1 2027 (quarter to 30 Sep 2026) had TV advertising +60.1% and total ad revenue +47% to $2.08B, and political ads above $350M, a midterm record, with over $250M on owned stations. CBS's network and owned stations share the midterm political cycle and NFL season. Fox's World Cup (Jun-Jul) has no CBS equivalent, so the transmission is partial.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separate history on the ad line for this name. TV Media ad surprises have been overshadowed by deal news on every print since the Nov 2025 merger.
findings.why_not_priced: Fox's print landed after Skydance last spoke about the quarter (its guide was set 4 Aug). Paramount's guide presumably assumed some political revenue, but a record cycle on a peer's stations suggests upside to the TV Media ad line that the stale Aug guide does not reflect. If it were priced, the Q3 consensus would sit above the guide range, and the aggregator numbers do not show that clearly.
findings.independence: Proxy only. Neither the company nor a direct counterparty has confirmed CBS political dollars. Fox SEC 8-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001754301/000162828026068663/foxearningsreleaseq127.htm

findings.finding: Leverage is the bear line. S&P cut the rating to BB on projected ~7.6x leverage lasting into 2027. The company issued second-lien notes at 8.25-9.125% coupons ($6.0B 2031, $4.0B 2034, $1.4B 2036). Debtwire models 6.16x net leverage on realised synergies, with covenant headroom relying on credited synergies. The pro forma balance sheet carries $82.4B of debt. A combined-company FCF or transformation-cost frame weaker than the 3.0x-by-2029 path would hit the equity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the day leverage concerns and the S&P cut hit (bond deal, late Sep/early Oct 2026), the stock fell as much as 9% intraday and closed down about 5% (https://parameter.io/investors-punish-paramount-skydance-psky-over-leverage-concerns-as-wbd-deal-nears-close/).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock is -50% from its high and the leverage is public. It stays filed because the first combined cash-flow, interest and transformation-cost numbers arrive on this call. The financing question has a clear answer: the money bought WBD, not a ramp, so the sign is negative but small. The size is cut because the skew (-25.5, calls paid) argues against a downside print.
findings.independence: Second-lien terms are in the same 8-K family as the pro forma (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0002041610/000110465926113913/tm2626659d7_ex99-2.htm). The S&P BB cut is via parameter.io. This finding and the synergy finding are two sides of the combined outlook; they share the 6 Oct targets as their reference but rest on different facts (synergy precedent vs leverage arithmetic).

findings.finding: Positioning leans to the upside and is not crowded short. 25d skew is -25.5 vol points (calls paid), put/call OI 0.16, SI 3.56% of float, DTC ~3.5-4. Musk was reported (Semafor/CNBC, 22 Oct) to have put ~$1B into Skydance, and the stock rebounded from $7.06 (14 Oct warrant ex-date close) to $8.29. Supply overhang sits above: 470.7M warrants struck at $12 and financing equity bought at $12.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The day the Musk report ran, 21-22 Oct, closes went 7.10, 7.87, 7.79. The rise came the day before the dated reports, and the stock was roughly flat on the report day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the rebound and the call skew already reflect it. It is sized small and kept because a low-expectations equity with paid upside and a 3.6% short interest gives an asymmetric reaction to any constructive outlook, though not a squeeze.
findings.independence: SI from https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/skyd/statistics/. Warrant mechanics from https://www.thewrap.com/industry-news/business/skydance-warrants-issued-stock-reaction/. Skew from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: Paramount+ subscribers were guided 'flattish' q/q for Q3 (81.6M at Q2, which included a 1.8M loss from a non-renewed international agreement). UFC, the price rise and retention are the bull story, so a flat sub line lands inside the guide and is not a catalyst.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Aug 2026 print reported +2M subs and the stock rose +4.5%. No print since the merger has turned on subs alone.
findings.why_not_priced: Inside the company guide, so the market was told to expect it. Filed because a net loss would read badly against the UFC narrative.
findings.independence: Same document as the EBITDA-beat finding. Paramount+ 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0002041610/000204161026000054/psky-20260630.htm

findings.finding: GAAP will be noisy. The Q3 guide flagged ~$200M of transformation costs hitting FCF, and Q2 carried $153M of WBD transaction costs plus $35M of restructuring. Q3 will carry more deal, financing and ticking-fee-related costs into the 6 Oct close (WBD holders received ~$31.02 against $30 headline). A large GAAP loss or headline EPS miss is likely and below operating income.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Nov 2025 print showed a $257M GAAP loss and an EPS miss, and the stock rose +9.8% on the savings target and guide. Holders have looked through deal costs before.
findings.why_not_priced: Expected one-offs with no path to the guide. Kept at a fraction because headline EPS screens (FXEmpire -$0.06 vs others +$0.11-0.13) disagree, and the wire headline may print a 'miss'.
findings.independence: Same document as the EBITDA finding. Payout detail at https://virginiabusiness.com/paramount-skydance-completes-warner-bros-merger/

baseline_tension: The mild long lean agrees with the strongly call-bid skew (-25.5) and the 5d bounce, so part of it is priced. It cuts against the -50% drawdown and the 20d run-up, which are distorted by the warrant ex-date. p_up is held at 56 rather than higher for that reason.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6: the EBITDA-beat finding is a reported-quarter item on a pre-close entity, and the name has sold a beat before (May -4.2%). Cut from +0.8 to +0.5.
Lesson 5 (documents beat inference): the synergy-upsize finding rests on precedent, not a document. Cut from +1.5 to +1.2. The Fox proxy cut from +0.4 to +0.3.
Lesson 7 (sign against a strong skew) and lesson 4 (financing is a question; the money bought WBD, the leverage is public): leverage negative cut from -0.8 to -0.5.
Lesson 6 (inside the guide toward 0): Paramount+ flattish subs cut from -0.2 to -0.1. Lesson 2 (one-offs at a fraction): GAAP deal costs cut from -0.2 to -0.1.

Last section of the file (a history built from the wrong events): checked. The 'no history' basis was wrong in the other direction, because the four prior 2.02 prints are this registrant. I rebuilt them from confirmed release dates; abs_move stayed 7.5.
